* Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud.
* Solid understanding of the Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing.
* Experience managing sandboxes and deploying changes to production.
* Automation experience with Flow Builder.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working directly with US client stakeholders.

=========================

Job Type: PermanentApplication Deadline: 18 November 2026

**Title:** Senior Technical Consultant - Record Keeping Platform (RKP)

**Department**: RKP Delivery

**Location:** Gurgaon/London

**Reports To:** Associate Director - Engineering & AI

**Level: 6**

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our Record Keeping Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

**About your team**

With a global presence across more than 25 locations around the world, Fidelity International provides investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks and financial institutions to wealth managers

and private individuals. The goal of the Record Keeping Platform team is to build a profitable $500bn business by becoming the partner of choice for all an individual’s and family’s financial needs.

**About your role**

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Technical Consultant with deep expertise in SOR, SOT and the wider Record Keeping Platform (RKP).

The role requires strong technical knowledge of the platform's architecture, application components, data structures, processing workflows, business rules, interfaces and integration dependencies.

The successful candidate will take technical ownership of complex platform changes, lead detailed solution design, undertake hands-on engineering and troubleshooting, and provide specialist guidance to engineering and delivery teams. A key aspect of this role is the ability to understand existing platform behaviour, identify technical and functional dependencies, and translate business requirements into secure, reliable and maintainable engineering solutions.

The specialist will also contribute to the progressive modernisation of RKP, helping bridge existing platform capabilities with modern engineering practices, cloud technologies and evolving architectural patterns.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise, strong engineering judgement and the ability to independently resolve complex platform challenges.

**Key role responsibilities**

* Act as a senior technical subject matter expert for SOR, SOT and the wider Record Keeping Platform (RKP), providing deep hands-on expertise in platform architecture, application components, business processes, data models and integrations.
* Lead end-to-end technical solution design and architecture documentation for complex platform enhancements, regulatory changes and business requirements, ensuring alignment with engineering standards.
* Perform detailed technical impact analysis across application code, databases, batch processes, business rules, interfaces and upstream/downstream system dependencies.
* Remain actively involved in hands-on engineering, including Java/SQL development, code analysis, debugging, technical prototyping, code reviews and implementation of critical changes.
* Provide specialist expertise in relational databases, complex SQL, stored procedures, query optimisation, data structures and application performance tuning.
* Design and troubleshoot complex transaction processing, batch workloads, data reconciliation and integration flows, ensuring data integrity, consistency and operational reliability.
* Lead technical aspects of data migration, transformation and reconciliation, ensuring accuracy, traceability and continuity of business-critical operations.
* Drive practical modernisation of RKP components by identifying technical debt, simplifying legacy implementations and adopting modern architecture, APIs, cloud technologies and reusable engineering patterns.
* Lead investigation, root-cause analysis and resolution of complex production incidents across applications, databases, integrations and infrastructure, implementing sustainable corrective actions.
* Ensure application security, data protection, performance, scalability, resilience and other non-functional requirements are embedded throughout solution design and implementation.
* Champion modern engineering practices, including automated testing, branching strategies, CI/CD, DevOps, environment management and quality engineering.
* Leverage specification-driven development, AI-assisted engineering and automation, where appropriate, to accelerate code understanding, impact analysis, development and testing while maintaining enterprise governance.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership, mentoring and specialist escalation support to developers and engineering teams, promoting engineering excellence and knowledge sharing.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, solution walkthroughs and 3 Amigos sessions, ensuring clear acceptance criteria and shared understanding of requirements.
* Support production releases, deployment readiness, rollback planning, hypercare and operational monitoring to maintain platform stability and service continuity.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation covering architecture, application dependencies, interfaces, design decisions and operational knowledge to reduce key-person dependencies.
* Provide technical feasibility assessments, reliable engineering estimates, risk analysis and dependency management to support effective project and delivery planning.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts, product owners, architects, enterprise technology teams and production support, communicating technical decisions, trade-offs and risks effectively.
* Take end-to-end ownership of technical quality and solution readiness, ensuring secure, maintainable and reliable delivery while continuously improving platform performance, engineering practices and business outcomes.

**About you**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Deep SOR, SOT and RKP Expertise: Significant hands-on experience with SOR, SOT and the wider Record Keeping Platform, including architecture, application components, business processes, data models, interfaces and system dependencies.
* Financial Services Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of investment, retirement, pension administration or record-keeping platforms, including complex business rules, transaction processing and reconciliation.
* Hands-on Engineering Proficiency: Advanced experience in Java, SQL, relational databases and integration technologies, with proven ability to analyse, develop, debug and enhance complex enterprise applications.
* Database and Performance Engineering: Strong expertise in SQL optimisation, stored procedures, batch processing, data integrity, performance tuning and troubleshooting complex data processing issues.
* Technical Solution Design: Proven experience in solution architecture, detailed technical design, impact analysis, software design patterns and integration across interconnected enterprise systems.
* Production Engineering and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, implement sustainable fixes and ensure application stability, security and operational resilience.
* Modern Engineering, Cloud and DevOps: Strong understanding of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps, application security, cloud technologies, APIs, microservices and modern engineering standards.
* Platform Modernisation and Engineering Innovation: Experience modernising legacy applications, reducing technical debt, improving engineering productivity and adopting reusable enterprise patterns and automation.
* Technical Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to provide hands-on technical leadership, mentor engineers, own technical quality and collaborate effectively with business, architecture, engineering and enterprise teams to deliver sustainable solutions.
* AI-Native Engineering and Agentic Development: Strong experience or demonstrated capability in AI-assisted software engineering, agentic development, specification-driven development and AI-enabled SDLC practices, leveraging AI for code analysis, reverse engineering, impact assessment, solution design, development, testing and modernisation while ensuring quality, security and governance.

**Our Values**

**Integrity** – Doing the right thing, every time and putting the client first.

**Trust** – Empowering each other to take the initiative and make good decisions.

**Our Behaviours**

**Brave -** Challenging the status quo, being accountable and speaking up.

**Bold -** Acting with conviction, encouraging diverse thinking and keeping things simple.

**Curious** - Learning to do new things in better ways and encouraging fresh thinking.

**Compassionate -** Having empathy, caring for colleagues, clients & community.

**Feel rewarded**

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.

For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

As an international financial services organisation, we are in-scope of international regulations in the way that we carry out our work. **What you'll work on**
-----------------------

* **Integration modernisation:** Lead the move of nCino integrations with our core lending platform off MuleSoft onto direct, well-tested integrations, and retire the old flows safely.
* **Platform upgrades:** Plan and lead nCino release upgrades across the team, including impact analysis, regression testing and rollout.
* **Production support:** Own production stability for the lending platform. Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and fixes so loans keep booking without disruption.
* **Regulatory change:** Deliver regulatory changes in nCino, such as Basel 3.1 requirements, with the audit trail and change control a regulated bank needs.
* **Integrations:** Design and build integrations between nCino and our CRM, customer portal, customer due diligence (KYC) and credit bureau services, including via our data warehouse.
* **Data privacy and access:** Lead data privacy work such as record anonymisation, and standardise access rights and the security model across the org.
* **Standard features first:** Enable standard nCino features (for example product packages) instead of building custom code, and reduce existing customisation where possible.
* **Test automation and delivery:** Work with QA to grow automated test coverage and improve CI/CD for Salesforce deployments.
* **Documentation and debt:** Keep technical documentation current, and tidy up technical debt and deprecated components.

**What you should know**
------------------------

* 12+ years of Salesforce engineering experience, including at least 3 years on nCino (Commercial Banking / Loan Origination) or a similar lending platform built on Salesforce
* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Platform Events, and a clear view of when to use configuration and when to use code
* Strong knowledge of the nCino data model and features: relationships, loans, product packages, covenants, collateral and the loan lifecycle
* Integration design experience: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, event-driven patterns, Named Credentials and OAuth, plus error handling and reconciliation between systems
* Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and field-level security, and how to design these for least privilege
* Salesforce DX, source control (GitHub), automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset or Copado)
* Experience planning and running managed-package upgrades with minimal disruption to users
* Experience working in a regulated environment, such as a bank or financial services firm, with change control, auditability and data protection (GDPR)
* Proven technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, breaking down and estimating work, and making sound trade-offs
* Clear communicator who can work directly with Lending, Credit and Product stakeholders across UK, US and India time zones

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer II, Application Architect, Integration Architect) and nCino certifications
* Understanding of commercial lending products and processes, including syndicated lending
* Experience with data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery) and moving data between Salesforce and other systems
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering

--------

We're pragmatic about our technology choices. These are some of the things we use at the moment:

* Salesforce Platform, nCino
* Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flows, Platform Events

* **Focus on outcomes over outputs -** Solving a problem for users that translates to business results is our goal. Measurements focused on that goal help us to understand if we are succeeding.
* **Practice continuous improvement -** We optimize for feedback now, rather than presume what might be needed in the future and introduce complexity before it will be used. We share learnings in blame-free formats, so that we do not repeat things that have failed, but still have confidence to innovate.
* **Seek to understand our users -** We constantly seek understanding from data and conversations to better serve our users' needs.
* **Test outside-in, test first -** TDD keeps us confident in moving fast and deploying regularly. We write scenarios first, coupling tests to behavior rather than implementation.
* **You build it, you run it -** We embrace DevOps culture and end-to-end ownership of products and features. Every engineer has the opportunity to lead delivery of features from start to finish.
* **Embrace difference -** No egos - people listen to and learn from others at all levels, with strong opinions held loosely. A wide range of voices heard to the benefit of all.

#### **About The Position**

**About Coralogix**

Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.

We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.

**The Role**

Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.

Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.

A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.

  
  

**What You Will Build**

**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade
  

  

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets

* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration

* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows

* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  

  

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.

* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:
**Locations**: London | Lisbon | Gurgaon

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

description:
**Job Description:**

Technical Lead, CPaaS Platform About the role We are hiring a Technical Lead to drive the architecture and engineering quality of our CPaaS platform. The platform lets businesses message their customers over WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Instagram and voice from one API, one inbox and one automation builder. You will design the backend systems that move millions of messages reliably and bill for them correctly. You are also expected to be comfortable in the frontend, where customers build campaigns, flows and templates. This is a hands-on role: you will write code most weeks, lead design reviews, and help grow a small team of backend and full stack engineers.

**Location: Gurugram · Experience: 5+ years**

**What you'll do**

Backend architecture and design Drive the design of core services:

messaging send and receive, delivery receipts, contacts, campaigns, workflow automation, integrations and billing.

**Design for high-volume, event-driven traffic:**

idempotent sends, retries with backoff, outbox patterns, at-least-once delivery and correct reconciliation of delivery status. Shape multi-tenant data models with strong isolation (row-level security, scoped credentials, per-org limits). Define clean contracts between services and with telecom and messaging providers, and keep them versioned and tested. Write and review design docs and ADRs; make trade-offs explicit and choose options that hold up as we scale.

**Frontend and product**

Review and contribute to our web app and admin panel: campaign builder, flow builder, inbox, template management and billing screens. Make sure APIs serve the UI well: pagination, optimistic updates, error states and real time updates. Work with product and design to turn fuzzy requirements into a buildable, phased plan.

**Engineering leadership**

Lead and mentor a team of 3–5 engineers; run design and code reviews, and take part in technical hiring. Set standards for testing, CI gates, observability and secure coding, and keep them enforced in the pipeline rather than by memory. Help own production health: on-call practice, incident response, blameless postmortems and SLOs for send latency and delivery. Partner with DevOps on cloud infrastructure, deploys and cost.

**Backend design (the core of this role)**

5+ years building production backend systems, with some experience leading a small team or owning a major component end to end. Strong experience with TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS preferred), or strong Go/Java/Kotlin with willingness to work in TypeScript. Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions, migrations on live tables. Hands-on experience with event streaming and queues (Kafka or similar): partitioning, ordering, consumer lag, dead-letter handling. Distributed-systems judgement: idempotency, exactly-once vs at-least-once, race conditions, back-pressure, rate limiting. Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, authn/authz (JWT, RBAC), audit trails. Has shipped and run services on a public cloud (GCP preferred) with containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. Solid observability practice: structured logs, metrics, tracing, alerting you actually act on.

**Frontend fluency**

Working knowledge of React and Next.js: can read, review and ship features, not just consume APIs. Understands state management, data fetching and caching, forms, and accessibility basics. Can spot when a UI problem is really an API problem, and fix it at the right layer. Leadership and ways of working Writes clear design docs and explains trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers. Reviews code for correctness first: edge cases, concurrency, failure modes, security Values tests that can actually fail, and verifies behaviour in real environments before declaring done. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving priorities in an early-stage product.

CPaaS, telecom or messaging experience:

WhatsApp Business API, SMS aggregators, RCS, DLT registration in India, or delivery-report handling. Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar) for long-running automations and scheduled journeys. Usage-based billing: wallets, prepaid credits, metering, payment-gateway webhooks. Integrations with commerce and CRM platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Meta lead ads) via OAuth and webhooks. Security depth: secrets management, KMS, webhook signature verification, dependency and supply-chain hygiene. Load testing and capacity planning for bursty campaign traffic. Experience using AI coding tools well, with review and guardrails in place.

**About this opportunity:**

  

Join Ericsson as an Engineer – Data Centre, an integral role where you will have the opportunity to manage, maintain, and deployment of the physical infrastructure within the data centre. This role involves both building and operational support activities to ensure optimal data centre performance and reliability. The engineer will be actively involved in activities such as rack installation, cable laying, network device installation, cable dressing, and material handling. In addition, the role includes troubleshooting hardware and connectivity issues, coordinating with customers and OEM vendors, and ensuring all incidents are resolved within defined SLA timelines.

 **What you will do:**

* Help the installation of data centre devices (Arista, Juniper, Cisco, Ciena, Nokia) and infrastructure by guiding the field team to fully understand the entire scope.
* Address technical queries and provide solutions to ensure smooth execution of field work.
* Collaborate with the customer to identify and resolve any discrepancies in the detailed document aligned with the scope of work.
* Prepare the Bill of Materials for consumable items based on the project's requirements.
* Contribute to POC and document drafting related to the process methodology.
* Ensure field technicians receive ongoing skill development through new training programs.
* Stay current with the latest technologies and best practices in the data centre industry.
* Involvement in the upcoming decommissioning efforts, in tendum with the build team, will include dismantling equipment, acquire packaging materials, and handle the entire process through customer portals.
* Work in collaboration with the project manager on upcoming projects and submit technical quotations based on the customer\-defined scope of work for invoicing.

 **The skills you bring:**

* Total years of experience \- 2 to 5 years
* Proven experience in installation, commissioning, and decommissioning of hardware within data centre environments.
* Proven experience in remote troubleshooting and ability to operate effectively in a data centre environment.
* Strong technical expertise in data centre operations and IT infrastructure, including servers, switches, routers, cabling systems, and fibre optics.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain physical infrastructure within a data centre environment.
* Strong hands\-on experience and in\-depth understanding of Cisco, Ciena, Juniper, and Arista network devices and technologies.
* Strong expertise in optical, copper, and fibre cabling systems, including fibre standards, connector types, and cable management practices.
* Flexible and adaptable, capable of working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Skilled in reviewing, enhancing, and maintaining Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and operational guidelines.
* Strong focus on service excellence with a customer\-first mindset, leveraging multi\-domain technical competence.
* Adheres strictly to approved MOPs, safety protocols, and operational instructions without deviation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across teams and with customers.
* A proactive team player with strong interpersonal skills, able to work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficient in spoken and written English to support effective communication in global environments.
